title.name: Title
title.description: The title displayed for this sub-step.

description.name: Description
description.description: Optional secondary description text shown beneath the title.

state.name: State
state.description: Explicit state of the sub-step. When omitted, state is derived from context.

visualCompleted.name: Visual Completed
visualCompleted.description: When true, renders the sub-step as completed visually regardless of its actual state.

contentOnly.name: Content Only
contentOnly.description: When true, renders only the children content without the interactive sub-step row.
